'''Swamp serpents''' were [[Color/Legends|brown]], predatory [[Snake/Legends|serpents]] native to [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. Though air-breathers, they were excellent swimmers. They hunted in schools consisting of ten to fifteen individuals.
